spec.description: Media processing tools: video intelligence (inspect, scene detection, frame extraction), contact sheets, AI upscaling, background removal

tools.description: Inspect a video file: get duration, resolution, codec, fps, bitrate, audio info. Use when user says: 'inspect this video', 'video details', 'what format is this video'.
Extract frames from a video at intervals, keyframes, or a specific count. Use when user says: 'extract frames', 'grab stills from video', 'get screenshots from video'.

mode.description: Extraction mode: interval (every N seconds), keyframes (I-frames only), or count (N evenly-spaced frames). Default: count

value.description: Seconds for interval mode, or frame count for count mode. Default: 10

tools.description: Detect scene changes/boundaries in a video using frame difference analysis. Use when user says: 'detect scenes', 'find scene changes', 'scene boundaries'.

threshold.description: Scene change sensitivity (0.0-1.0, lower = more sensitive). Default: 0.3

tools.description: Generate a thumbnail image from a video at a specific timestamp. Use when user says: 'video thumbnail', 'generate preview image', 'screenshot at timestamp'.

time.description: Timestamp in seconds to capture. Default: 1

tools.description: Generate a contact sheet (thumbnail grid) from a folder of photos with filename and EXIF metadata overlay. Use when user says: 'contact sheet', 'thumbnail grid', 'proof sheet', 'photo grid'.

columns.description: Number of columns in grid. Default: 5

showExif.description: Show EXIF metadata overlay. Default: true

thumbSize.description: Size of each thumbnail in pixels. Default: 300

tools.description: Upscale an image to 2x or 4x resolution using AI enhancement. Use when user says: 'upscale photo', 'increase resolution', 'enlarge image', 'make larger for printing'.
Remove the background from an image, outputting a transparent PNG. Use when user says: 'remove background', 'transparent PNG', 'cut out subject', 'product cutout'.

outputFormat.description: Output format: png or webp. Default: png
